subject: CAIQ fieldwalk & evidence sprint — scheduling and open asks
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Chang <emily.chang@harborhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ fieldwalk & evidence sprint — scheduling and open asks

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for taking the compliance review with us. To make the CAIQ review efficient for both teams, we propose a short "fieldwalk" call (30–45 min) to go through the highest-risk sections, followed by a 2-week evidence sprint where we exchange artifacts via a shared Drive folder.

Proposed agenda for the fieldwalk:
- Quick intros and goals (5 min)
- CAIQ high-priority lanes (data residency, access controls, logging, encryption) (20 min)
- Evidence handoff process and owners (10 min)
- Next steps & timeline (5–10 min)

Availability from our side: Wed 8/25 10:00–11:30 PT, Thu 8/26 13:00–15:00 PT. If neither works, suggest windows that fit you.

Pre-call asks (if you can share ahead of time):
- A copy of the most recent SOC 2 Type II (PDF) or assessor contact for dry access
- Preferred SFTP/Drive location and any access cutoffs
- Any narrow scope restrictions for the sprint (PII subsets, production vs staging)

I've attached a first-pass CAIQ mapping (redwood_caiq_mapping_v0.1.xlsx) that highlights where we believe artifacts will map — it's rough, but should speed the call.

Thanks,
Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Emily Chang <emily.chang@harborhealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Harbor Health Security Team <security@harborhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ fieldwalk & evidence sprint — scheduling and open asks

Sergio,

Appreciate the clear agenda — this looks good. Wed 8/25 10:30 PT works for our lead (I can do 10:30–11:15).

A couple of quick notes before the call:
- We can share our SOC 2 Type II pdf; I'll confirm with legal and aim to upload by EOD Tue.
- Our evidence folder will be a scoped Google Drive; we allow Viewer access for third parties and can add individual emails.
- Scope: production systems only; exclude sandbox and developer test datasets.

Two initial technical questions to flag for the fieldwalk:
1) For encrypted at-rest, do you use envelope encryption with customer-specific KEKs or a platform-managed KMS?
2) How do you surface access logs for long-running inference jobs? Are they pulled from the orchestration layer or the nodes directly?

If you can drop short answers in the thread, we can prep a little before the meeting.

Thanks — I'll send a calendar invite for Wed 8/25 10:30 PT and add the Drive link once permissions are set.

Best,
Emily Chang
Director, Security Operations
Harbor Health
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Chang <emily.chang@harborhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2026 13:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ fieldwalk & evidence sprint — scheduling and open asks

Emily —

Great, Wed 8/25 10:30 PT is confirmed on our side. Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=harbor-caiq-fieldwalk-20260825 (I'll accept once you send).

Quick answers to your flagged items so the call can be focused:
1) Encryption at-rest: We use a platform-managed KMS by default; customers can opt into customer-managed keys (CMKs) in Dedicated/Private deployments. For hosted accounts we offer envelope encryption with a per-customer data key stored in our KMS. We'll bring the KMS diagram and key lifecycle notes to the meeting. (Attachment: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf — short overview).
2) Access/logging for long-running jobs: We capture node-level audit logs from the serving runtime plus orchestration events. Logs are pushed to our centralized logging pipeline (ingest metrics + audit stream) and we can provide scoped exports (log snippets) for requested time windows. Typical artifacts: log export (gzip), signed collection manifest, and a short README describing filtering.

Pre-call attachments: redwood_caiq_mapping_v0.1.xlsx (mapping + tentative owners), redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (what to expect in our SOC docs).

On the call we'll mark which CAIQ questions require artifacts vs written answers and assign owners for the 2-week sprint. Marissa will lead evidence collection and will be the action owner for any document pulls.

Action items before the call:
- Emily: upload SOC 2 pdf and add emily.chang@harborhealth.com as Drive owner + add us as Viewers (Emily)
- Sergio: send calendar invite and confirm Zoom link (done on our side)
- Kimberly/Marissa: review the mapping and flag any obvious gaps (internal)

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Sergio
From: Emily Chang <emily.chang@harborhealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Harbor Health Security Team <security@harborhealth.com>

Subject: Re: CAIQ fieldwalk & evidence sprint — scheduling and open asks

Sergio — thanks for the quick responses and for the attachments. I uploaded the SOC 2 Type II report to the Drive and set Viewer access for sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com and marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-harbor-evidence

A follow-up from my security engineer after a quick scan: can you confirm whether API keys used for internal tooling are rotated automatically, or if rotation is a manual process today? They asked for the approximate rotation window (e.g., 30/60/90 days).

I'll be on the call in about 35 minutes.

—Emily
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emily Chang <emily.chang@harborhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: CAIQ fieldwalk & evidence sprint — scheduling and open asks

Sergio / Kim — quick internal note and confirmation after the fieldwalk:
- Meeting went well; we captured action owners and prioritized CAIQ lanes: data encryption, access controls, logging exports, and incident response.
- API key rotation: on our platform, service-level API keys are rotated on a 90-day schedule by default; we do allow more frequent rotation via an automated job in Dedicated/Private setups. I'll include a short readme and rotation logs export in the evidence folder (redwood_caiq_mapping_v0.1.xlsx will be updated).
- Next steps (timeline):
  * By EOD Thu 8/26: Updated CAIQ mapping and evidence checklist (Marissa)
  * Week of 8/30: Evidence sprint window opens; delivering requested log exports (Sergio/Marissa)
  * HubSpot: HS-23456 will track status and artifacts.

Attachments to drop in Drive this week: redwood_caiq_mapping_v0.2.xlsx, api_key_rotation_manifest.csv, logging_export_sample_20260701.gz

I'll post the updated mapping and the rotation manifest in the shared Drive and ping Emily once they are available.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
